summary.business_type: Editorial/reference site (programmatic country x category etiquette-rule database, Astro static on Cloudflare)
top_findings: No About, Contact, Privacy, or Terms pages exist anywhere (all 404); zero author attribution site-wide
dateModified is identical to the crawl/build date on every page, no datePublished exists - reads as fabricated freshness
Article body copy is 50-90 words per page; category/country hub pages have ~0 unique words
Every internal link triggers an unnecessary 307 redirect due to a trailing-slash mismatch
Zero images anywhere on the site despite inherently visual/gestural topics
quick_wins: Set trailingSlash: 'always' in astro.config.mjs to remove the site-wide 307 redirect
Add Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable for /_astro/* assets
Add security headers (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, CSP) via Cloudflare _headers/Worker
Add /llms.txt indexing the 6 categories and top articles
Differentiate the duplicate meta description shared by every category/country page

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Fully static/SSR Astro site, zero JS dependency for indexable content
robots.txt valid and correctly points to sitemap-index.xml
57/57 sitemap URLs return 200 with zero redirects
Correct self-referencing canonicals everywhere, no accidental noindex
HTTP to HTTPS redirect works, Brotli compression enabled
Clean, human-readable URL taxonomy

findings.title: Zero security headers site-wide
findings.description: No HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy on any page or asset.
findings.recommendation: Add a Cloudflare _headers file or Worker middleware setting the standard security header set.

findings.title: Every internal link triggers a 307 redirect
findings.description: All internal hrefs (nav, category chips, cross-links, breadcrumb JSON-LD item URLs) omit the trailing slash and 307-redirect to the canonical trailing-slash URL.
findings.recommendation: Set trailingSlash: 'always' in astro.config.mjs and fix breadcrumb URL generation to match.

findings.title: Redirect uses 307 instead of 301/308
findings.description: The trailing-slash redirect is a permanent URL-structure decision but returns a temporary status code.
findings.recommendation: Override with an explicit 301/308 via Worker/redirect rule, or eliminate the redirect entirely per the fix above.

findings.title: Hashed static assets not cached long-term
findings.description: /_astro/*.css is served with max-age=0, must-revalidate despite content-hashed filenames safe to cache forever.
findings.recommendation: Add a _headers rule: Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable for /_astro/*.

findings.title: Duplicate meta descriptions across category/country pages
findings.description: All category pages share the identical description 'Unwritten etiquette rules from around the world.'
findings.recommendation: Template the description per category/country name.

findings.title: Thin content at scale across 37 article pages
findings.description: Unique body copy runs ~500-700 characters per article.
findings.recommendation: Add regional variation, exceptions, and context per rule.

findings.title: BreadcrumbList JSON-LD uses non-canonical URLs
findings.description: Breadcrumb item URLs omit the trailing slash and will 307-redirect if followed.
findings.recommendation: Generate breadcrumb item URLs from the same canonical-URL helper used for link rel canonical.

findings.title: No og:image/twitter:image sitewide
findings.description: No page includes an og:image or twitter:image tag; twitter:card is summary not summary_large_image.
findings.recommendation: Generate a branded OG image template and add og:image once images exist.

findings.title: /search/ is in the sitemap with no indexable content
findings.description: Search results render client-side via Pagefind; raw indexed content is essentially empty.
findings.recommendation: Add noindex,follow to /search/ and remove it from the sitemap.

findings.title: Article schema missing image, author, datePublished
findings.description: Current Article JSON-LD omits fields recommended by Google for full rich-result eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Add author (Organization) and datePublished now; add image once real images exist.

findings.title: Empty-body 404 page
findings.description: 404 responses return content-length 0 with no navigation or search box.
findings.recommendation: Ship a real 404 page with a link to the homepage and search.

findings.title: www subdomain has no DNS record
findings.description: www.etiquetteness.com fails to resolve rather than redirecting to the apex domain.
findings.recommendation: Add a DNS record and redirect rule for www to apex.

findings.title: Sitemap has no lastmod dates
findings.description: sitemap-0.xml includes loc only, no lastmod for any of the 57 URLs.
findings.recommendation: Emit lastmod sourced from real content-edit history.

findings.title: IndexNow protocol not implemented
findings.description: No IndexNow key file or integration found.
findings.recommendation: Add IndexNow given the existing Cloudflare Workers deploy pipeline.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Clean heading hierarchy with quotable, self-contained H1 claims
Article + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD present and well-formed
Consistent, unique, descriptive title tag pattern

findings.title: No About, Contact, Privacy, Terms, or methodology pages exist
findings.description: All verified 404; none appear in the sitemap. Trustworthiness (30% of E-E-A-T weight) has no baseline signals.
findings.recommendation: Publish About and Contact pages stating who runs the site and how to reach them.

findings.title: No author attribution anywhere
findings.description: No byline, editorial team page, or credentials on any page sampled.
findings.recommendation: Add a visible author/editorial-team byline or a site-wide methodology page.

findings.title: Article body copy is extremely thin
findings.description: 50-72 words per article across 9 sampled pages; category/country hubs have ~0 unique body copy.
findings.recommendation: Deepen each article with 150-300 words of genuine context: regional variation, exceptions, why the custom exists.

findings.title: dateModified equals crawl date on every article
findings.description: No datePublished exists; dateModified appears to be a build timestamp rather than a genuine edit date.
findings.recommendation: Populate datePublished distinct from dateModified, sourced from real content history.

findings.title: Meta descriptions identical across category/country pages
findings.description: 9/9 checked pages share the exact same description.
findings.recommendation: Differentiate descriptions per page.

findings.title: Single-source citation per fact with no cross-verification
findings.description: Each article cites exactly one third-party source with no independent verification shown.
findings.recommendation: Add a second corroborating source where feasible.

findings.title: Homogeneous template with no differentiation signal
findings.description: All 37 pages share identical structure with no editorial distinctiveness.
findings.recommendation: Add unique context/depth per entry.

findings.title: No internal contextual linking within body copy
findings.description: Only links are the outbound citation and same-country related links.
findings.recommendation: Link to related categories, not just same-country entries.

findings.title: Undefined severity tag (strict/casual)
findings.description: No legend or methodology explaining the classification.
findings.recommendation: Add a methodology page defining the tag criteria.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique, descriptive title tags following a consistent pattern
Single H1 per page matching a clear, quotable claim
Clean URL structure

findings.title: Duplicate meta descriptions across category/country pages
findings.description: Same issue as flagged in Technical/Content: all category pages share one description.
findings.recommendation: Template descriptions per page.

findings.title: Internal linking gaps
findings.description: No cross-category internal links within body copy; only same-country related links.
findings.recommendation: Add contextual internal links to related categories.

findings.title: Systemic redirect on internal links
findings.description: Non-trailing-slash hrefs cause a 307 on nearly every internal navigation.
findings.recommendation: See Technical SEO fix #1.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: All markup is valid JSON-LD using https://schema.org context
Article + BreadcrumbList present and structurally correct on all 37 article pages
Breadcrumb target URLs verified live (200 OK)

findings.title: about property is a bare string, not a Thing entity
findings.description: Schema.org's about property range is Thing; a plain country-name string is invalid.
findings.recommendation: Wrap in a Country/Place entity.

findings.title: No author property anywhere
findings.description: No author field and no visible byline in rendered HTML.
findings.recommendation: Add author as Organization until real bylines exist.

findings.title: No image property
findings.description: Site ships zero images; Article image field is required in practice for enhanced rich results.
findings.recommendation: Add once real per-article images exist; do not use placeholders.

findings.title: dateModified identical across all sampled articles
findings.description: Matches request date on every article regardless of topic, suggesting it is computed at build/request time.
findings.recommendation: Derive from real content-edit history.

findings.title: Category pages have zero JSON-LD
findings.description: 6 substantial, internally-linked hub pages carry no structured data at all.
findings.recommendation: Add CollectionPage + BreadcrumbList to category pages.

findings.title: No Organization/publisher schema
findings.description: No Organization entity exists anywhere on the site to reference from Articles.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization schema once, reference via publisher on every Article.

findings.title: No datePublished field
findings.description: Only dateModified is present.
findings.recommendation: Add datePublished distinct from dateModified.

findings.title: No homepage SearchAction
findings.description: Homepage WebSite schema has no potentialAction despite a working /search/ page.
findings.recommendation: Add SearchAction pointing to /search.

findings.title: Missing @id/mainEntityOfPage
findings.description: Not required but recommended for entity de-duplication.
findings.recommendation: Add @id references across the @graph.

findings.title: Breadcrumb names are raw slugs, not title-cased
findings.description: e.g. 'japan' instead of 'Japan' in BreadcrumbList display names.
findings.recommendation: Title-case breadcrumb names.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: No images anywhere means no LCP-image or CLS-image risk
Lean DOM (90-380 tags), no custom application JS on content pages
font-display: swap already in use, mitigating invisible-text risk

findings.title: Every internal link triggers a 307 redirect
findings.description: Adds an extra round trip (~450-600ms observed) before nearly every internal navigation completes.
findings.recommendation: Set trailingSlash: 'always' in astro.config.mjs.

findings.title: Render-blocking Google Fonts stylesheet
findings.description: Every page loads fonts.googleapis.com synchronously in head; preconnect and font-display:swap are already correctly set.
findings.recommendation: Self-host the two variable woff2 files and preload the primary above-the-fold weight.

findings.title: Hashed assets not cached long-term
findings.description: Same issue as Technical: /_astro/* served with max-age=0, must-revalidate.
findings.recommendation: Add immutable long-lived caching via Cloudflare _headers.

findings.title: pagefind-ui.js loads without defer
findings.description: 120KB script on /search has no defer/async attribute.
findings.recommendation: Add defer to the script tag.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot, CCBot, Google-Extended) all confirmed allowed via robots.txt and live UA spot-check
Fully SSR/static content present in raw pre-JS HTML
Source attribution present and linked on articles

findings.title: llms.txt missing
findings.description: https://etiquetteness.com/llms.txt returns 404.
findings.recommendation: Add /llms.txt indexing categories and top articles.

findings.title: Passage length too short for optimal AI citation
findings.description: Body text runs 71-90 words vs. the 134-167 word optimum; zero lists found on any sampled page.
findings.recommendation: Expand entries with a Do/Don't list and one FAQ-style H2 each.

findings.title: No question-based in-content headings
findings.description: Only headings are boilerplate 'More from X' related-link blocks.
findings.recommendation: Add natural-language question headings mapping to likely queries.

findings.title: Zero multi-modal content
findings.description: No images, figures, video, or tables on any sampled article despite visually-gestural topics.
findings.recommendation: Add at least one illustrative image per article with descriptive alt text.

findings.title: No About page or Organization/author schema
findings.description: Same trust gap flagged by Content and Schema audits, also weakens AI citation-selection authority signals.
findings.recommendation: Add About page plus Organization schema with sameAs links.

findings.title: dateModified unreliable freshness signal
findings.description: Identical 'today' timestamp on every article, no datePublished, zero sitemap lastmod entries.
findings.recommendation: Fix dates to reflect real content history.

findings.title: No images exist anywhere on the site
findings.description: Zero img, picture, figure, or background-image elements across homepage, category, country, and all sampled article pages, flagged independently by Technical, Schema, GEO, and SXO.
findings.recommendation: Add at least one illustrative, alt-texted image per article, prioritizing the most visually-gestural topics (bowing, cheek-kissing, chopstick use, hand placement).

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Set trailingSlash: 'always' in astro.config.mjs and fix breadcrumb URL generation
Add security headers (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, CSP) via Cloudflare _headers/Worker
Publish About + Contact pages
Fix dateModified/datePublished to reflect real content history; add sitemap lastmod
Fix Article schema about property to a Country/Place entity instead of a bare string

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add long-lived immutable caching for /_astro/* hashed assets
Add Organization + publisher schema site-wide, referenced from every Article
Add CollectionPage + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD to category pages
Differentiate meta descriptions across all category/country pages
Add /llms.txt indexing categories and top articles
Change trailing-slash redirect status from 307 to 301/308 for any residual cases
Add noindex,follow to /search/ and remove it from the sitemap

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Deepen every article to ~140-160 words with a Do/Dont list and one FAQ-style H2
Add a second corroborating source per fact where feasible
Add at least one illustrative, alt-texted image per article
Build real guide-depth content at the category/country hub level
Add FAQPage/HowTo/ItemList schema where genuine Q&A/how-to content exists
Add a methodology page explaining the strict/casual severity tag
Run the seo-programmatic skill for a dedicated thin-page-ratio review

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Add www DNS record and redirect to apex
Ship a real 404 page with navigation and search
Add IndexNow protocol integration to the deploy pipeline
Re-run Performance and SXO audits with real Lighthouse/CrUX/PageSpeed and live SERP data
Begin off-site brand-mention building (YouTube, Reddit) for top categories
Explicitly decide and document AI crawler access policy

artifacts.screenshots_dir: screenshots/ (not captured - no Playwright/browser access in this environment)
